x: Next we have Bert Smith at last prepared to "do or die," with "Nobby" Fletcher at his heels. Hello! here comes the "three starred nap," Tom Cotton, in quite a hurry.

Bignall, our Highgate member, second, and "Nobby" Fletcher third. The result proved that we have a very useful team for the Brighton race and, moreover, have several useful reserves; which, in the case of withdrawals, is a most important factor.
First position was shared by two of our promising younger runners—both eligible for the South of the Thames Senior event—in "Bert" Mitchell and "Nobby" Fletcher.
Webb, taking things very easily, completed the course and in company with Bill Rice and Nobby Fletcher, finished 37th, 38th and 41st respectively, closely followed home by W.
